questions.stem: Why must patients who receive a kidney transplant take immunosuppressant drugs?

options.text: To prevent infections entering through the surgical wound
To stop the immune system from rejecting the donated kidney
To help the new kidney start filtering blood more quickly
To reduce pain and swelling after the operation

questions.explanation: The immune system recognises the transplanted kidney as foreign tissue and may attack it. Immunosuppressant drugs reduce this immune response to prevent rejection, though this also makes the patient more vulnerable to infections.
